question: In the coal oxidation study for coalbed methane, what contact angle did sample HRC-SX-C have before oxidation?
rendered:
According to the excerpt from page 5 of the paper "Alterations in Coal Permeability and Adsorption Capacity Post Oxidation Treatment: Insights into Enhancing Coalbed Methane Production":

"The CA of most samples before the oxidation treatment ranged from 120° to 135°, and that of sample HRCSX-C was significantly higher at 142°, showing a strong hydrophobicity."

So, sample HRC-SX-C had a contact angle of 142° before oxidation.
